fusions.name: Farrier's Brand
fusions.desc: A kick with a red-hot shoe that costs 4% of your maximum health, deals 8 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wildfire Run
fusions.desc: Gallops through a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage and leaving everything in it [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Cinder Track
fusions.desc: Stamps a burning hoofprint into the ground that lasts 10 seconds and burns an enemy within 2.5 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Struck Sparks
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, a spark from your hooves strikes the nearest enemy within 4 tiles for 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
